exposure: Epidural ropivacaine combined with 0.5 mg/mL dexmedetomidine
outcome: Median effective concentration (EC50) of epidural ropivacaine for labor analgesia
cohort: Sixty full-term primiparous women undergoing labor were enrolled and divided into two groups.
finding: The median effective concentration (EC50) of epidural ropivacaine for labor analgesia was significantly reduced from 0.083% to 0.062% when combined with 0.5 mg/mL dexmedetomidine.
